name: jetc-profile-live
description: Tools/Perf/JetcProfile/Live.sh and its Jet twin JetcProfile/Live/run.jet, which run `jet perf attach` on a running jet for a second (sampled from outside, with its child processes) and show the trace's functions with `jet perf view`. Sampling needs a live process the user may signal, and no pid names one on every machine, so the cases stop at the refusals before it: no arguments and more than one (a seconds word included), a pid that is not a positive whole number (zero, a suffix, a trailing newline), and a pid no process has, which `kill -0` refuses with its status.
